Frequency once per day (once per hour with Court's Legends)

Trigger The follower would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

Your follower is so loyal to your cause that they fight to the finish. They avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1.
